name: international-payment-orchestration
description: Multi-rail intelligent international payment orchestration platform with smart routing, AI fraud detection, currency conversion, and automated decline recovery.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "intelligence,backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:backend

author: Harsh Kumar
